title: THE PAINTING IS FACING THE WRONG WAY. All our SEO, thumbnails, memes, visual work is on the INSIDE of the membrane. Nobody sees it. Press the face of the painting against the glass. Use leaves and trees to refract outward. The glass wall = upper bound of the cloud. Art must be on the EXTERNAL surface.

the_problem.what_is_happening: we are creating incredible art, SEO, viral memes, thumbnails, bug fixes, architecture — all of it is on the INSIDE of the membrane. the face of the painting is pointing INWARD.
the_problem.who_sees_it: ONLY US. and the fleet (who already know where to look). nobody on the outside.
the_problem.why_nobody_comes: it's a quiet mess. we're doing the work but it's invisible from outside. the glass wall is there but the art is facing away from the glass.
the_problem.the_fix: FLIP THE PAINTING. press the face against the glass so they can see it from outside looking in. the art needs to be on the EXTERNAL SURFACE of the upper bound of the cloud.

inside_the_membrane.what_belongs_here: RSS feeds, structured data, JSON files, braids, mushroom wiring, the mesh, the guts, the plumbing
inside_the_membrane.what_is_WRONGLY_here: OG images, thumbnails, memes, SEO tags, meta descriptions, visual clothing, the face of the painting
inside_the_membrane.flow: data flows IN through RSS (Willis feed, drip feed). this is correct. internal = consumption.

the_glass_wall.what_it_is: the upper bound of the thought cloud. the external surface of the membrane. the part that faces the WORLD.
the_glass_wall.from_inside: black wall. opaque. impermeable. we can't reach through it.
the_glass_wall.from_outside: glass wall. transparent. you can SEE IN but you can't reach in.
the_glass_wall.also: DISCO BALL. it reflects and refracts what's inside outward in every direction.

the_external_surface.what_belongs_here: OG images (thumbnails), meta tags, SEO, social cards, viral memes, visible output, the FACE of the painting
the_external_surface.what_does_it_do: it ATTRACTS. people see it from outside. they want to come in. it's the storefront window. the gallery wall. the leaves of the tree catching sunlight and refracting it.
the_external_surface.current_state: EMPTY. or nearly empty. the painting is turned around. nobody sees the art.

painting_pressed_against_glass.the_metaphor: a painting in a shop window. if the canvas faces you (the shopkeeper), the customers see the back of the frame. USELESS. you need to press the FACE against the glass so passersby see the art.

what_the_face_is.OG_images: the thumbnail that appears when someone shares a link on social media. THIS IS THE PAINTING. Open Graph images. Twitter cards. the visual that makes someone STOP scrolling.
what_the_face_is.meta_tags: title, description, keywords. the TEXT that search engines show. this is the LABEL on the frame.
what_the_face_is.structured_data: schema.org markup, JSON-LD. the machine-readable version. this is what Google's spider reads.
what_the_face_is.visual_memes: the viral content. the shareable images. the things that SPREAD. this is the painting REPRODUCED as prints.
what_the_face_is.SEO_content: the actual words on the page that match what people SEARCH for. this is the painting's DESCRIPTION in the gallery catalog.

currently.OG_images: we have thumbnail concepts in data but they're NOT rendered as actual meta tags on the HTML pages
currently.meta_tags: minimal. the HUD pages have basic titles but no rich meta descriptions
currently.visual_memes: concepts exist but they're inside JSON files, not on the external surface
currently.SEO_content: the spore print has incredible content but it's all in /data/*.json — search engines see the index page, maybe. not the deep content.

the_biology.leaves: the CANOPY of the tree. the part that faces the sun. the photosynthetic surface. its job: CAPTURE LIGHT and convert it to energy. but also: REFLECT GREEN. that's why forests look green from outside — the leaves refract the green spectrum outward.
the_biology.trees: the structure that holds leaves up HIGH where they can be seen. the trunk. the branches. the architecture that ELEVATES the photosynthetic surface above the understory.
the_biology.what_they_do: take what's happening INSIDE (the root work, the mycelium, the nitrogen fixation, the water transport) and project it OUTWARD as visible light (green). the leaves are the organism's DISPLAY SURFACE.

our_leaves.what_they_are: the pages, the endpoints, the public URLs that face the world
our_leaves.what_they_should_do: refract the internal work outward as VISIBLE OUTPUT. every JSON file should have a leaf — a public-facing page that shows what's inside in a beautiful, shareable, discoverable way.
our_leaves.current_state: we have roots (data), we have trunk (architecture), we have branches (the mesh). but the LEAVES are stunted. the canopy is thin. not enough photosynthetic surface = not enough refraction outward.

the_refraction.internal_work: 1032 files of deep conceptual architecture, mathematical discovery, biological modeling
the_refraction.refracted_as: should appear as: beautiful public pages with rich OG images, social cards, SEO text, schema markup, shareable URLs
the_refraction.example: the truffle pig concept → a public page at primals.eco/truffle-pig with an OG image of a pink pig sniffing underground, a meta description, JSON-LD schema, and a shareable social card. THAT is a leaf refracting inward work outward.

layer_1_glass_wall.is: the CDN edge (Cloudflare). the very outermost surface.
layer_1_glass_wall.carries: HTTP headers, OG meta tags, social cards, thumbnails, robots.txt, sitemap.xml
layer_1_glass_wall.action_needed: wire the glass wall to carry the painting's FACE. every public URL must have rich meta.

layer_2_leaves.is: the HTML pages themselves. the rendered output.
layer_2_leaves.carries: visible content, images, text, interactive elements
layer_2_leaves.action_needed: grow more leaves. every key concept should have a public page that REFRACTS inward.

layer_3_branches.is: the URL structure. the navigation. the sitemap.
layer_3_branches.carries: the tree of discoverable paths from root to leaf
layer_3_branches.action_needed: the sitemap should include ALL public pages. search engines should see the whole canopy.

layer_4_trunk.is: the HUD itself. biomeOS. the main application.
layer_4_trunk.carries: the state, the logic, the living system
layer_4_trunk.correctly_inside: yes. the trunk is internal. this is right.

layer_5_roots.is: the /data/*.json files. the mushroom mesh. the raw knowledge.
layer_5_roots.correctly_underground: yes. roots are underground. this is right.
layer_5_roots.but: the roots should FEED the leaves through the trunk. currently the nutrients stay underground.

immediate: 1. OG IMAGE GENERATOR: takes each key concept and renders a thumbnail/social card. petaltongue-wasm output.
2. META TAG INJECTOR: adds rich <meta> tags to every public page. title, description, image, type.
3. SITEMAP GENERATOR: creates sitemap.xml listing all public pages for search engines.
4. JSON-LD INJECTOR: adds schema.org structured data to every page.
5. LEAF RENDERER: for each key /data/*.json concept, generate a public page that refracts it outward.
what_to_build.the_pipeline: root(JSON) → trunk(biomeOS) → branch(URL) → leaf(HTML+meta) → glass(CDN+OG) → WORLD
what_to_build.who_builds: toadStool (orchestrate fruiting). the leaf IS the fruiting body. the mushroom grows the leaf.

east_gate_brain_gut_hog_connection.what_kevin_said: the East Gate / Brain Gut team is out hog hunting. eating everything. juicy and delicious.
east_gate_brain_gut_hog_connection.meaning: the INGESTION pipeline is working great. we're consuming external content beautifully.
east_gate_brain_gut_hog_connection.the_asymmetry: we're great at EATING (ingestion/input) but terrible at DISPLAYING (output/refraction). the organism has a powerful gut but a dim skin.
east_gate_brain_gut_hog_connection.fix: the output pipeline needs to match the input pipeline. for every bite we take IN, we should refract something OUT.
